description: Bounded public disposition for the SSD action-memory path on a real model: the frozen 22-task panel A/B (hit stratum 84.508 s to 16.574 s, 20/20 solved; miss stratum 0.9981), the audit retraction of the 5.10x headline as contaminated with an admissible clean multiplier of 1.771x, the packed-extent reduction of instrumented physical read bytes by 72.1%, and the missing state-reuse identity gate. The executing runtime tree, model weights, container bytes, and raw receipts are excluded from publication; values below are sanitized summaries of campaign-local receipts.
model_name: AliceAI-Foundation-80B-A3B-Base (custom alice_ai hybrid KDA linear-attention + MoE)
model_revision: campaign artifact; no weight payload is part of this repository
model_download_source: public base checkpoint exists; no weight payload or container byte is part of this repository
quant_name: Q3.9-MIX (52 x Q4_K + 44 x Q3_K expert tensors, trunk q8_0, control f32)
hardware_phenotype: RX9060XT16-NITRO-GFX1200-RADV-2026.08.27-v1; RX 9060 XT 16 GB, gfx1200; frozen server configuration; NVMe cold tier
gpu_configuration: RX 9060 XT 16 GB, gfx1200; frozen server configuration; NVMe cold tier
prompt: frozen 22-task panel; the task prompts are excluded from publication
warmup: one A/B per task (baseline row then enabled row) on a frozen panel

expected_range.state_reuse: NOT CLAIMABLE - no identity gate exists in the runtime

tolerance.panel_ratio: one A/B per task on a frozen panel; the miss path is ~1.00x by design
tolerance.packing: instrumented physical read bytes, not modelled

known_limitations: The 5.10x headline is retracted; the admissible clean multiplier is 1.771x.
The 30->8 token and 12->4 forward figures are a timing proxy, not model inference.
Accuracy is preserved only in the tested cases (20/20 panel).
State reuse has no identity gate and is not claimable today.
